SRE.WrongSystem: Shadowrun Edge only works with the {system} system.

Wizard.Title: Item Wizard
Wizard.PresetGMOnly: Only the GM can save presets.
Wizard.PresetNeedsName: Enter a name to save the preset.
Wizard.PasteHint: Copy a row from a rulebook table (the name and its columns in order) and click Parse. The wizard reads DV (3P/2S), modes (SA/BF), AR (10/9/6/—/—), ammo 15(c), availability 2(L), cost 750¥ and "Rating × …" formulas.
Wizard.Name: Name
Wizard.RatingHint: Fields with "R" (e.g. R*0.1, R*1000) are calculated from the Rating.
Wizard.ARHint: Five ranges: close, near, medium, far, extreme. Empty = none (—).
Wizard.BulkHint: You can paste a whole table, one row per line, and create all items at once.

Mods.Title: Built-in mods
Mods.Empty: Drop a mod here (e.g. silencer, scope, armor modification) from a compendium or the Items directory.
Mods.Hint: When the item is dragged onto a character, the mods are installed automatically and their effects apply right away.
Mods.OnlyMods: Only mods (type "mod") can be dropped here.
Mods.Missing: Some mods were not found and were skipped.

Effect.Title: Mod effects
Effect.Hint: A mod changes the item it is installed in. The value may depend on the Rating, e.g. R or +2.
Effect.Label: Effect name (e.g. Bipod deployed)
Effect.ToggleHint: The effect starts disabled and is switched on on the item sheet when it applies (e.g. only against fire).
Effect.ActorHint: The augmentation changes the character carrying it. A value of "R" follows the item Rating. A "toggled" effect (e.g. adrenaline pump) is switched on on the item sheet.

Catalog.Label: Custom catalog (world)
Catalog.GMOnly: Only the GM can add items to the catalog.
Catalog.Locked: The compendium "{name}" is locked; unlock it to add items.
Catalog.BuiltInModsHint: They are installed when you drag this item onto a character.

Grade.Title: Implant grade: {name}
Grade.Hint: Rulebook grades (p. 282) change Essence, cost and Availability. The grade can be changed later with the button in the item sheet header.

Setting.Name: Ask for implant grade
Setting.Hint: When cyberware or bioware is dropped on a character, ask for its grade (used, alpha, beta, delta).
